titles.romaji: Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai: Kanketsu-hen 1
titles.english: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club The Movie – Finale – Chapter 1
titles.native: ラブライブ！虹ヶ咲学園スクールアイドル同好会 完結編 第1章

description:
The first in a trilogy of Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai films that continues the story beyond season two and the OVA.

Ayumu, Kasumi, Shizuku, Kanata, Emma, and Lanzhu enter the School Idol GPX in Okinawa.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
